question: What status does someone attain who, even without initiation, eats the offering impelled by will of shiva and rite?
premises: Even one devoid of initiation may act if impelled by will of shiva and rite.
If such a person eats by devotion, an action is performed under that condition.
That person becomes complete, a samaya-initiate, and well cultivated.
inference: Whoever, even without initiation, is impelled by will of shiva and rite and eats by devotion becomes complete, a samaya-initiate, and well cultivated.
uncertainties: Relation between eating by devotion and initiation status is asserted here but not argued.
Distinction between samaya-initiate status and higher statuses remains open in this verse.
plain_english: Whoever, even without initiation, is impelled by the will of shiva and by rite and eats by devotion becomes complete, a samaya-initiate, and well cultivated.
